versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00323 The Operating System API shall check in extended mode all pointer arguments for a NULL_PTR and return E_OS_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS in this case unless NULL_PTR is explicitly allowed as a valid pointer address value in the API parameter specification.
The Operating System API shall check in extended mode all pointer arguments for a NULL pointer and return E_OS_PARAM_POINTER in extended status if such an argument is NULL .
